visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian woman with long hair styled in intricate braids, wearing a shimmering champagne-colored evening gown adorned with sequins and featuring a high leg slit, stands on a grey-carpeted stage. She holds a silver flute and speaks with animated facial expressions and hand gestures to an audience in a large hall. Behind her are large black professional speakers, stage lighting fixtures, and vertical yellow banners displaying the Rotary Club logo and Chinese characters. (2) The performer begins playing the silver flute with high energy, swaying her torso and shifting her weight to the rhythmic beat. Animated rectangular overlays appear at the top of the frame, showing colorful anime-style character illustrations and traditional Japanese scenery associated with the song theme. The stage is brightly lit by white and purple spotlights that reflect off her sequined dress. (3) The camera angle shifts to show the audience composed of several men sitting at round tables within a banquet hall setting. They are seen cheering, waving their hands, and holding up smartphones to record the performance. Floating text bubbles with the word 'Hey' in various colors and sizes appear repeatedly across the screen to visualize the audience's rhythmic chanting and high engagement. (4) Back to a medium full shot of the performer on stage as she executes a fast-paced solo section. Her fingers move with high precision and speed across the flute keys while she maintains a focused yet joyful expression. The background consists of vertical blue and white striped curtains, and the overhead lighting shifts in intensity to match the musical buildup. (5) The woman concludes her performance with a final flourishing high note and a graceful pose, gesturing toward the crowd. The video shows brief flashes of the audience members clapping and smiling at their tables. The lighting on the stage softens as she prepares to exit, and the animated overlays disappear from the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A solo female voice dominates the audio, speaking with a high pitch and rapid, enthusiastic cadence. Her tone is welcoming and energetic, with no background music, creating a clear and articulate monologue against a faint indoor ambient noise floor of a large room. (2) A high-energy J-Pop style electronic track suddenly enters at approximately 150 BPM. The music features a driving electronic drum beat and layered synthesizers. Simultaneously, a bright and piercing flute melody begins, played with high technical precision and a sharp spectral centroid. (3) Rhythmic vocalizations of 'Hey!' from several male voices are heard, perfectly synchronized with the heavy downbeats of the background music. The crowd's cheers are loud and indicate high emotional arousal, momentarily competing with the flute's high-frequency harmonics in the mix. (4) The audio texture becomes hyper-dense as the flute performs a rapid series of ascending and descending scales. The background music maintains a constant high-intensity beat strength with no pauses. The interplay between the synthesized bass and the live flute creates a rich, broadband spectral profile. (5) The track reaches a climax with a sustained high-pitched flute note followed by an immediate hard cut to the sound of enthusiastic applause and celebratory shouting from the crowd. The female performer's voice returns briefly with a cheerful, slightly breathless quality to acknowledge the audience's response.
